title: New Member Training

title: Bio-AI Workshop
description: Weekly workshops on biology and AI, encouraging interdisciplinary exchange and innovation.

description: Introduction to career development and cutting-edge directions for MBIE students.

title: Collaborative Projects
description: Collaborative specialized projects for students with established research capabilities.
